cultural.vision_reason: Documentary studio-mounted photograph of Sitka, Alaska Tlingit people in traditional dress (blankets, fur hat) with fish and spear, taken in front of a wooden fence — a genuine ethnographic scene of Tlingit daily life/dress.

physical.title: stereoscope photograph (black and white)
physical.summary:
Stereoscope photograph (black and white); group of three Tlingit(?) men and one Tlingit(?) woman standing in front of a wooden fence; the man on the far right is wearing a blanket wrapped around his shoulders, and his trousers rolled up, whilst holding a pole over his shoulder with a fish speared onto it; an additional fish leaning on the fence behind the man on the right; the man second from the right is similarly dressed with a cloth hat; the man second from the left is wearing a fur hat, a waistcoat, a blanket wrapped around himself, a pair of trousers and a pair of shoes; the woman is wearing a blanket wrapped around herself; view of a western-style building in the background; Sitka, United States of America. 
Albumen print
